record.title: Verify physical D capability across a further normal reboot
record.intent: Establish repeatable native loading and retained option state independently of the deployment boot.
requirements: Proceed only after accepted first D startup. Under a separate fresh capture request one normal reboot without further native or entitlement changes; a client timeout is retained without retransmission while bounded observation resolves the actual boot.

Require a new boot ID and stable full UI, unchanged public identity and signed APK, exact derived standalone mapping/hash, ten ordinary statuses with BND false, stable license/key files and repeated raw/effective18/18.
Preserve timing, UI, raw SCPI, process/map and bounded-memory evidence, capture drop statistics and host restoration; retain the scoped software-capability claim.
acceptance: The physical software capability and ordinary options persist across the independent reboot.
